summary: Implemented `StablePML` and `Absorber` boundary support across the public API, typed IR, boundary compiler, staged runtime path, examples, docs, and representative absorption tests.
key_findings: `StablePML` and `Absorber` are now first-class public boundary edges with Tidy3D-aligned defaults, explicit `Boundary` / `BoundarySpec` constructors, and zero-dimension coercion behavior shared with baseline `PML`.
Boundary IR now distinguishes `PML`, `StablePML`, and `Absorber` through typed payloads (`PMLIR`, `StablePMLIR`, `AbsorberIR`) plus family-specific axis and face metadata on `BoundarySpecIR`.

Runtime compilation keeps the existing staged damping-layer seam: `StablePML` lowers onto the baseline PML coefficient path with a separate profile tag, while `Absorber` lowers into conductivity-only attenuation coefficients with a reflective outer-wall policy.

The absorbing-boundary runtime and state allocator now handle all three absorbing families through the shared staged kernel path, while kernel metadata advertises explicit `stable_pml` and `absorber` mode support.

Focused verification passed with `PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_boundaries.py tests/test_ir.py tests/test_imports.py tests/test_containers.py` and `PYTHONPATH=src python -m compileall src/autofdtd`.

artifacts.description: Added `AbsorberParams`, `StablePML`, `Absorber`, and public constructors for the new absorbing boundary families.
Extended absorbing-boundary compilation to prepare StablePML and Absorber coefficient profiles and per-family face metadata.
Extended staged boundary kernels to handle StablePML and Absorber runtime modes.
Updated runtime state allocation so all absorbing families share the staged boundary execution path.
Added typed IR lowering for `StablePML`, `Absorber`, and `AbsorberParams`.
Added representative tests for StablePML and Absorber compilation, IR lowering, state allocation, reflective ghost behavior, and staged absorption.
Updated boundary-scope documentation to cover the implemented absorbing-boundary subset and current limits.
Structured task result for this loop iteration.

follow_up_notes: The current `StablePML` implementation is a preset-driven extension of the staged PML backend, and `Absorber` is a conductivity-ramp subset with a reflective outer wall. `task-023` should build ABC-family behavior on the existing absorbing-face metadata without redesigning the shared staged boundary seam.
